answer:
No. The current specification for the DR-520 is more restrictive than the specification that was in the 2024/2023 manuals.

* Service Bulletin SB-2026-07 is a revision of the DR-520 vent limit:

> “This bulletin revises the maximum vent run specification for the DR-520 dryer.” [service-bulletin#1]

Revised limit:

> “The maximum vent run for the DR-520, using 4-inch rigid metal duct, is now 25 feet, with up to 3 elbows counted against that length.” [service-bulletin#2]

> “This supersedes the 35-foot, 4-elbow figure published in the DR-520 owner's manual (revision 2024-03-01) and in the Installation Guide (revision 2023-09-01).” [service-bulletin#2]

A 30-ft run exceeds the now-current 25-ft maximum, even though 3 elbows is within the “up to 3 elbows counted against that length” allowance. The DR-210 is not affected by the bulletin.

Under the pre-revision manuals in effect at the time of a 2025 installation the 30 ft / 3-elbow run would have been within the then-published 35 ft / 4-elbow limit, but it does not meet the current 25 ft limit.
